synthesis.headline: No — keep Python, and do not make it more comprehensive: the trading loop is ~95% idle and IO-bound, the code is already 188,786 tracked lines serving a $780 paper account, and the pre-registered n=50 readout lands in roughly a week, so the honest answer is to change nothing structural, let the experiment run, and spend the interval fixing measurement instruments that are currently lying to you.
synthesis.language_rationale:
The rewrite case was argued in three forms and all three were refuted.

SPEED IS NOT SCARCE, AND THE OFFERED PROOF WAS ALSO WRONG. Live sampling of outputs/status.json every 6s, 2026-09-15T02:32:56Z-02:33:26Z: cycle_duration_sec 0.23, 0.23, 6.24, 0.74, 0.23, 0.22 against system.polling_interval_sec 5.0; feed_latency_ms 137-144; runner_state RUNNING, mode DRY_RUN, 4 open positions, equity 780.37. Process CPU measured from Win32_Process for PID 10732: 280.48s over 5617.1s wall = 4.99% of one core. The claim that 2,004 ms of the hot path is "Kraken's rate limit" does not survive: that number is our own client-side sleep (config.json exchanges.kraken.rate_limit_per_sec=3 -> data/_http.py:74 _min_interval=0.3333s -> data/_http.py:111-124 time.sleep under a held lock; reproduced to ~2ms with no network at all), and the REST Depth loop it timed was superseded 2026-07-15 by the Kraken v2 websocket book (config.json websockets.kraken_enabled=true; main.py:2828-2838 reads the WS cache first). The single 51.67s stall brackets to a Windows Update install window (event ids 43/19 at 20:39:24/20:39:30 local, an Ntfs shadow-copy check, a Time-Service id 158) in a process using 5% of a core. No compiler touches any of that; the two levers that actually moved this path were a protocol change and a config integer.

CORRECTNESS-BY-CONSTRUCTION DOES NOT BUY THE DEFECT CLASS THAT KEEPS FIRING. The QA-writes-production class (10 or 11 instances — the two registers disagree; tests/test_qa_isolation.py omits outputs/trade_paths.csv, which scripts/smoke_test.py:1110 separately calls "TENTH") is ambient filesystem authority, not a type error. std::fs::File::create(path) typechecks in Rust; Haskell's IO marks the effect, not the destination; prod-vs-tmp is a VALUE. Worse for the rewrite case: the mitigation that actually enforces the static property is PEP 578 sys.addaudithook (tests/conftest.py:66-79, _ALLOWED = () at :49), a Python runtime capability most compiled languages do not offer. And the repo's own C++ already does the same CWD-relative thing (diode/lb_diode.cpp reads an outputs/ tree).

THE POLYGLOT MOVE THAT PAYS IS ALREADY MADE. diode/lb_diode.cpp is a compiled independent referee — offline, SAFE-class, feeding no decision path. That is the correct use of a second language and it exists. On 2026-08-21 it disagreed with Python 16 vs 21 accrued trips and THE DIODE WAS WRONG: a second implementation is valuable as a disagreement detector, not as an authority.

COST OF THE ALTERNATIVE. A rewrite discards 92,639 lines of tests (49% of tracked Python, re-derived), a hash-chained audit trail, and a pyright-zero shipped-scope ratchet. Any rewrite reaching the order lifecycle or fill simulator is COHORT_RESETTING under the era-9 moratorium and would restart an accrual now at 22/50 with ~8 days to the lean. A targeted compiled component is not justified either — numba 0.67.0 and polars 1.44.1 are already installed and unused on this path, and they are the cheaper experiment if CPU ever becomes the constraint.
synthesis.comprehensiveness_rationale:
More code is the wrong axis — and so is subtraction, which also failed.

MORE IS NOT THE ANSWER. 188,786 tracked Python lines (re-derived: git ls-files '*.py' | wc -l), tests 92,639, scripts 46,158, shipped scope ~49,900, supporting 22 closed round trips in the current era on a $780 paper account with a model that loses to the base-rate null out-of-sample. Evidence per line is the binding constraint and every additive proposal makes it worse. Model-side investment is separately frozen by the 2026-08-10 operator adjudication.

BUT SUBTRACTION IS ALSO NOT THE ANSWER, WHICH SURPRISED THE PANEL. All three deletion candidates failed. execution/venue_adapters.py (321 LOC) really has zero production importers — confirmed three ways including a runtime meta_path block with a firing control arm — but it carries scripts/smoke_test.py section [25]'s six check() assertions including the hostile flag-tamper pin for hard invariant 3, and it is docket item B4 awaiting operator sign-off (docs/HANDOFF.md:1058). execution/routing.py (133 LOC) really is write-only in the engine (main.py:768: AST gives one Store, zero Loads) — but deleting it removes the only pytest-layer invariant-3 pins, written in 2026-07 precisely because that gate was "covered by NOTHING", and its route() gate keys on a module constant no config edit can defeat, a second route to a first-order invariant. Total available subtraction: 454 LOC = 0.24% of the tree, paid for in assurance.

WHAT IS MISSING IS VERIFICATION — AND EVEN THERE THE GAP IS SMALLER THAN CLAIMED. Three separate "zero test pin" claims (RP-030 gap cap; watchdog venue divergence; watchdog pnl velocity) were refuted by pins living in scripts/smoke_test.py — a mandated DoD gate that `python -m pytest tests/ -q` never runs and no symbol grep finds, because those pins assert values rather than naming reason codes. The panel's own false-positive rate on coverage questions was 3 of 15 claims. The real defect is pin VISIBILITY, not pin absence.

THE GENUINE RESIDUALS, all verification, all small: (1) the watchdog's pnl-velocity COOLDOWN LATCH is a rubber stamp — a mutant replacing it with a pure level read passes all four smoke checks, because smoke's third call re-trips at exactly -6.0%; (2) the divergence detector cannot distinguish "venues agree" from "there is no second venue" (execution/fair_value.py:202-251 collapses to the Kraken microprice when the external book is empty) and silently skips an asset whose fair value is 0.0 (core/watchdog.py:166-168) — and this branch HAS fired in production (outputs/events.jsonl.1:17932, "venue divergence: ETH:174bps", 2026-09-11T13:50:00Z); (3) the firewall rate rung (FW-020/FW-021) has no behavioural pin anywhere, though 0 firings across 88,700 audit rows and a 60-submit budget against an all-time peak of 13 terminals/60s make it a backlog item, not a risk; (4) 13 of 40 decision points carry no behavioural pin. Every one of these is Python, found by Python tooling, closed by Python tooling. None argues for a language or a subsystem.

synthesis.what_would_change_my_mind:
THE LANGUAGE VERDICT FLIPS ON ONE MEASUREMENT, AND IT NEEDS NO CODE CHANGE TO TAKE: sample Win32_Process KernelModeTime + UserModeTime for the runner PID alongside outputs/status.json's cycle counter at the 5-second poll, from outside the process, for 24 hours. Today that ratio is 280.48s CPU over 5617.1s wall = 4.99% of one core, with mean CPU/cycle 0.264s against status.json's reported 0.23 - two routes agreeing to ~15% - and my own live sample (2026-09-15T02:32:56Z-02:33:26Z) shows 0.22-0.23s typical with a 6.24s excursion. If that sampling showed (a) sustained CPU above ~50% of one core, or (b) cycles whose CPU time - not socket wait, not our own data/_http.py throttle sleep, not host contention - routinely approaches polling_interval_sec 5.0, or (c) in-process work breaching order_timeout_sec 25 on the exit path, then the language question becomes live. Even then the answer would be keep_python_add_targeted_component: numba 0.67.0 and polars 1.44.1 are already installed and unused on that path, and they are a cheaper experiment than any rewrite. A FULL rewrite would additionally require that a defect be traced to Python's SEMANTICS rather than to a path-resolution convention Rust, Go and C++ share - and the repo's own C++ diode reading outputs/ by the same CWD-relative convention is evidence against that.

THE COMPREHENSIVENESS VERDICT FLIPS ON THE PRE-REGISTERED READOUT ITSELF: the n=100 verdict from scripts/cohort_eval.py. If it returns CONTINUE with the CI excluding -fee, capability work becomes justified because the strategy would have shown it pays. If it returns STOP (no gross edge, or cost-bound), the answer is fewer lines and a different question, not more code. Note in advance so it is not misread as a null when it arrives: cohort_eval's own cohort_effective_n (:623-672) deflated these 22 spans to effective_n 8.81 with SE inflation x1.58, so nominal 50 on ~2026-09-22 will probably deliver a weak lean, not a decidable one.
refuted_but_worth_naming: 'Era-9 accrual is STALLED and not approaching n=50' - FALSE, and this was the orchestrator's own premise. My own re-derivation from outputs/fills.csv (1,321 rows, mtime 2026-09-15T00:42:45Z, read 02:32:38Z), two routes agreeing: 22 closed round trips carrying exec_era 12-10d4d0c2 on every leg (21 book='', 1 book='long'), 26 opened, 3.643 closes/day over a 6.038-day span, closes on every UTC day 09-10 through 09-15 (3/7/1/5/5/1) with one genuine zero day on 09-09. n=50 ~2026-09-22. The 'stalled' evidence (live_labels_per_day_7d 0.0, admits_24h 0, tokens -0.9134) reads ml.probe_budget deques never persisted across the 13 era-9 restarts - a different instrument answering a different question. '5/5 slots full' is also false: status.json at 02:32:34Z lists 4 open positions; what IS true is that entries are being refused, with events.jsonl logging 'Blocked: max concurrent positions reached (filled + pending entries)' on nearly every cycle through 23:29-23:34Z on 09-14 - the ceiling counts pendings.

'2004ms of the hot path is exchange-side and survives any language' - the conclusion (no rewrite) is right, the mechanism is wrong: that 2,004 ms is our own time.sleep under a held lock, set by one integer in config.json, and the loop it timed was retired by the websocket book three days after the comment was written.

'RP-030 (the gap-at-risk cap) has zero test pin' - FALSE. scripts/smoke_test.py:2144-2152 asserts the exact clamp to 1e-6 in an isolated harness, and the branch is a no-op on money anyway: deployed gap f_max 4.0/15.0 = 0.2667 is looser than the hard position cap 0.25 applied 28 lines later at risk/position_sizer.py:604 (identical sized fraction across an exhaustive 1,000-point sweep; 0 firings in 88,700 audit rows). The real finding behind it: core/config_guard.py:2836-2839 never cross-checks gap f_max against max_position_size_pct_of_capital, so a risk control you believe is active is silently inert.

'The watchdog's venue-divergence and pnl-velocity trips have no behavioural test' - FALSE as stated; both are pinned at scripts/smoke_test.py:1954-1998 and mutation confirmed they discriminate. What is genuinely unpinned is narrower: the cooldown latch, the below-threshold anti-rubber-stamp case, and the self-comparison blindness.

'The control plane's CWD-relative literals mean the launch directory decides the destination' - FALSE for the live runner: runner.py:1922 os.chdir(Path(__file__).resolve().parent) anchors the process 63 lines before BotRunner is constructed, and relative Paths re-resolve per syscall. The relative literal is the mechanism of a deliberate run-from-anywhere anchor, not a leak past it. One genuine residual: scripts/reset_paper_capital.py:121 ControlChannel().send('stop') is bare while its three sibling scripts all pass an explicit path.
'Delete execution/venue_adapters.py / execution/routing.py' - both facts true, both actions wrong; see do_this_next rank 7.

'The pre-registered criterion is re-registered UNCHANGED in CLAUDE.md' - FALSE. The null moved -$0.33 -> -$0.27 with the cut-#12 fee rebook while the rule is phrased 'CI excluding -fee', the entire power block and the UNDETERMINED/extend-to-200 branch were not carried forward, and the instrument named as 'the same pre-registered machinery, untouched' computes a different statistic at a different n with no CI on any mean.

'The 51.42s worst cycle ever recorded' - not ever: _cycle_dur_max (runner.py:1139) is an in-memory latch reset on every restart, so it is the max of the CURRENT process. It also moved to 51.67 while a panelist watched.
synthesis.what_this_could_not_see:
NOTHING WAS EXECUTED. Task law forbade running pytest (5,384 tests), scripts/smoke_test.py, assurance_check or the overfit battery against a box holding a live runner. So every statement about what a gate DOES is read from source, and the single strongest available check - mutation: break a fix, watch the pin redden, restore - was structurally unavailable in the main checkout. Panelists who did mutate did so by replaying inputs against module source in throwaway namespaces, not in situ.

POSITION OUTCOMES: 11 of 15 claims were refuted, 4 survived (FW-021 unpinned; fill_hazard_report's dead subject; smoke's sentinel/control-queue reach; era-9 is accruing). The steelman-rewrite position went 0-for-3, which is the cleanest signal in the dossier - but a position that loses every claim also means the rewrite case was never made by its strongest possible advocate, only by the strongest one this panel could build in the time it had.

NEVER ADVERSARIALLY CHECKED, AND IT IS THE BIGGEST INPUT: the ML skill numbers. gbt OOF Brier 0.2498 vs a base-rate constant 0.2437 on 18,956 rows, and the flat learning curve (|delta_auc| 0.023 over 4x the corpus), were carried in as orchestrator facts. No panelist attacked them and I did not re-derive them. If 'the model loses to the base rate' is itself an instrument artifact - and this repo's record is that surprising measurements usually are - the comprehensiveness answer could change. Re-deriving it is absent from do_this_next only because model-side work is frozen by operator adjudication; verifying the MEASUREMENT is not frozen.

READ-ONLY SCOPE PREVENTED: planting a rogue venue in config.json to prove the SOR-001 guard fires (so its liveness is unproven in both directions - which cuts against removal, since the burden sits on whoever proposes it); running cohort_eval on a fresh cut; and any in-process profiling separating Python CPU from socket wait inside the 0.22s cycle, so '~4% ceiling for any language' is an upper bound on what a compiler could touch, not a measurement of interpreter time.

CORPUS BOUNDS ON THE ZEROS. outputs/events.jsonl rotates at 5MB, so 'the velocity branch has never fired' covers two retained files (~46,500 lines), not era-9's life - no onset claim is made. outputs/audit.jsonl zeros (FW-020/FW-021/RP-030) are over 88,700 rows on this box only; rotated predecessors were not scanned, and only 98 of 476 audit sessions are the live bot's, so contamination inflates activity counts and those zeros are upper bounds on cleanliness. Coverage greps were .py-only - a pin in a .bat or .yml harness would be missed.

MY OWN INSTRUMENT BROKE ONCE, AND I AM REPORTING IT RATHER THAN QUIETLY FIXING IT. My first era-9 trip derivation returned 14, not 22, because I summed entry size over legs matching side=='buy' OR purpose=='entry' - which counts the buy-side EXIT leg of every SHORT into the entry total and fails the 0.98 size test.
